topic: Data upload and correction for specific dates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data uploads and necessary corrections for client reporting. It was determined that a specific bug/condition only manifested on January 22nd, requiring immediate attention.

Regarding data correction, someone noted that the last 20 minutes of data need to be corrected in the communication sent to clients. 

Multiple files were uploaded and re-uploaded due to issues with duplicates and missing data (specifically mentioning 18 minutes of end-of-day data). The upload process was completed for several metrics/locations (lt, lv, dk, sg) for a single day. Data for Spain and Germany was intentionally skipped as the necessary data is unavailable.
decisions: Data correction must include mentioning the last 20 minutes of data to clients.
Files were re-uploaded after running recalc due to duplicate issues.
action_items: Write client communication regarding the data upload and corrections for January 22nd (and potentially other dates/metrics).
Ensure the client letter mentions correcting the last 20 minutes of data.
